procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys: 54 printed key numbers matching question labels + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-55 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-5, II 6-20, III 21-30, IV 31 (7 rows), V 32-41, VI 42-46, VII 47-50, VIII 51-54, IX 55); answer side keys 1-54 in the same order ('II.Spacing Replies', 'III. Right or False', 'IV .Match Write Answers' 31); q55 unkeyed. The LBA prints no difficulty distribution table -> quota_table 'absent' (R-E6). Difficulty per question: easy 40, average 6, difficult 5, untagged 4.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 56 (heading, 10 LOs — the list opens 'Define the concept of a community', apparently copied from another lesson; kept as printed) 57-58; A pdf 109-111.

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-5 (letter+text keys); s2 II fill q6-20; s3 III true/false q21-30; s4 IV match q31 (7 rows, heading '(Medium)'); s5 V one-mark vsa q32-41; s6 VI two-mark sa q42-46 (heading '(Medium)', questions untagged -> section_header average); s7 VII three-mark sa q47-50 (no tag on questions or heading -> null + 'no difficulty tag'); s8 VIII four-mark la q51-54 (heading '(Hard)'); s9 IX project q55 sa (heading '(Hard)').
MCQ q2: key 'b) Potential energy' vs option b 'Hidden Power' (the question side's mistranslation of potential energy) -> letter kept + 'key text paraphrases option'.

KEY SHAPE (control rev 3 ruling): V keys reprint the question on one line and give the answer on the next ('→ sunlight.'): value = the answer line with its leading '→' dropped (an arrow inside the line kept, q32 'The energy required to do → work.', q36); VIII keys reprint the question and list a.-d.: value/steps = the a.-d. lines; VI-VII keys print '→' lines: one step per '→' line, arrow dropped. answer_as_printed = the whole printed key (restated question and arrows included) on q32-q54.
T/F keys print only 'Okay' / 'Error' -> label form, R-E4a doubted on all ten.
Match q31: the key prints all seven rows in one run '1 → d. Power generation 2 → c. …'; values kept, letters dropped (rows 6-7 lettered f, g against column B's f, r).
q12's key makes the sentence circular -> 'key text does not address question' (as evs-5-06 q28). The lesson translates coal as 'Chicken' / 'Poultry' (q13, q47, q51) -> doubted.
q55 project (bottle cart with a sapling) prints no key -> 'no answer printed'. No figure.

TOPIC (R-E7): map v1 evs-5-13 s00 (Introduction, untickable), s01 Work, s02 Energy is essential to do work, s03 Different forms of energy and use, s04 Change of energy from one form to another, s05 Conservation of energy. Tagged by section title only (mapping in the unit summary).

Transcription: c5auto.py rules (pdftotext -raw reading order; the rules of evs-5-01's hand transcription) + the overrides in build_13.py; every entry read against the layout text / renders before commit. Marks R-E5; difficulty Medium -> average (R-E2), Hard/Hardest -> difficult, printed word kept; LO = the lesson's printed list (R-E10); R-E4 flags in the 'unclassified — …' form (control rev 2 E1); topics R-E7 (mapping in the unit summary).
